A single-cell layout wrapper preserves its nested data table as structured Markdown

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions { BrInTables = true, CompactTables = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
